source_files.role: The public class: seven operations, ported in src/format/oms_file.rs.
Delegation to the helpers; exportToJSON's FileNotWritable.
Read in full: every table definition, bind and insertion order.
Read in full: every schema-version branch, makeDataValue_, exportToJSON.
All six sections, executed on the Release build by the oracle; their assertions are in tests/oms_file.rs.

method: JSON export: the retained outputs under the upstream FuzzyDiff contract. Load/store: the Release build loaded each input and stored it again; the port loads the same input and stores it with OmsLoadOptions::source/OmsStoreOptions::source; the canonical, foreign-key-invariant dumps (schema SQL and all rows but the version row) of both databases must be identical. The loaded maps are compared field by field with the Release build's loaded values.
evidence_tier: 1 (executed Release build, ibminode06) for load, store and export; 3 for the native options

external_artifacts.note: driver.cpp, remote_run.sh, run.sh, dump_tables.py, make_dumps.sh, results/ (hashes.txt), dumps/ (dumps.sha256)
